headline: Phillies blow 6-0 lead, swept by Marlins
recap: The Phillies built a 6-0 lead through five innings on Wednesday in Miami but lost 8-6 to the Marlins, completing a three-game sweep. The Marlins answered with three runs in the fifth to cut the deficit, tied it with three more in the seventh, and took the lead for good with two in the eighth. Trea Turner went 2-for-5 with his 15th home run, Justin Crawford added two hits, and Bryson Stott drove in two runs on a double.

Jesus Luzardo was charged with all six Marlins runs over 6.1 innings, and Jonathan Bowlan allowed both eighth-inning runs to take the loss. At 57-52, the Phillies sit second in the NL East, six games behind Atlanta, and have lost three straight.

Thursday is an off day. Philadelphia opens a series at Baltimore on Friday at 7:05 PM ET, with Brandon Young starting for the Orioles; the Phillies had not named a starter as of this writing. No betting line is posted yet for the matchup.
